variants.text: Shoring is ordered, and an order is signed, and the order for this one still exists. Without it you are looking at a hole with good carpentry in it.
The water comes up warm and tastes of iron on a steppe where every other spring is cold and tastes of grass.
They will water here and they will not camp here, and there are twelve reasons and no two of them agree, which is what people do instead of remembering.
